data.gender_notes: Phillipe is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Phillipe comes from the name Philippos, which means 'lover of horses' or 'horse-born'. In the New Testament, Saint Philip was one of the twelve apostles, and a leader in spreading Christianity. The name has been popular among Christians ever since. The name Phillipe carries the meaning “Lover of horses or horse-born” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phillipe usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses or horse-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
